content.title: Tyson Fury Defeats Arslanbek Makhmudov via Decision — Here are Results for the Full Card
content.text: [commentator 1] This is big-time boxing.Fury vs. Makhmudov: Full Prelim and Main Card Results, Recap, and Fight InfoFury vs. Makhmudov leads a stacked April 11 card. Here’s exactly what went down on Netflix.Tyson Fury has made a career out of turning chaos into control. On April 11, he stepped back into the ring against a man built to do the opposite.Fury (35-2-1, 24 KOs) returned for a heavyweight collision with Arslanbek Makhmudov (21-2, 19 KOs), a relentless knockout artist whose fights rarely make it out of the early rounds. Fury, the sport’s most elusive strategist, outboxed Makhmudov en route to a decision victory.The bout headlined a stacked card on Netflix that also featured Conor Benn clashing with Regis Prograis in a high-stakes co-main event and a full lineup of heavyweight and cruiserweight matchups underneath. Around the ring, the broadcast was led by veteran host Elle Duncan, with Lennox Lewis, Laila Ali, and Carl Froch, while Mauro Ranallo called the action alongside David Haye and Andre Ward.Scroll on
